Overview

Managua is a city in MN with a population of 1,500,000. Nicaragua’s capital and largest city, a lakeside metropolis with a dramatic history and vibrant cultural scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
